description: This Swift source file defines the CLIInstaller enum which provides functions for locating, checking installation, and installing the 'openclaw' CLI tool, including parsing install event logs and executing shell commands.

classes.name: InstallEvent
classes.description: A struct representing an event during installation, including event type, version, and message.

methods.name: installedLocation
methods.description: Returns the installation path of the openclaw CLI if installed.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs the installation of openclaw CLI, updating the provided status handler with progress messages.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Checks whether the openclaw CLI is installed.

methods.name: installPrefix
methods.description: Generates the directory prefix for installation files.

methods.name: installScriptCommand
methods.description: Creates the shell command array to run the install script with specified version and prefix.

methods.name: parseInstallEvents
methods.description: Parses JSON-formatted install event output into a list of InstallEvent objects.

methods.name: shellEscape
methods.description: Prepares a string for safe inclusion in a shell command by escaping special characters.
